concepts.name: Precision die
concepts.description: A chamfered die with fewer contacts gives the original seal a sharper, more compact silhouette.
concepts.tradeoff: The V cutout needs generous spacing when reduced.
concepts.idea: Reference role: the original Silicon seal. Design a compact solid square chip body with precise chamfered corners, exactly two substantial short contacts on each of its left and right sides, and a bold deep V cut out of its center in background color. More compact and angular than the reference, fewer pins, confident clean mass. Beside it place exact uppercase text "VERITY" in custom tightly condensed heavyweight sans serif with chamfered terminals. The square mark should be only slightly taller than the lettering.

concepts.name: Open core
concepts.description: An open chip frame and a separate V create a lighter symbol with more breathing room.
concepts.tradeoff: The outline must stay strong enough for compact navigation.
concepts.idea: Reference role: the original Silicon seal. Create a substantially different lighter outlined chip emblem, a thick square outline with large open interior, two short pins on each left and right edge, and a separate strong simple ivory V inside. All outlines substantial and absolutely equal thickness, open negative space, flat geometry. NOT a solid filled chip with a dark V. To the right exact uppercase text "VERITY" in a refined medium-heavy condensed sans serif, lighter than the reference wordmark. Understated technical identity.

concepts.name: Diamond die
concepts.description: A rotated die introduces a more distinctive outer shape while keeping the V upright and readable.
concepts.tradeoff: The diamond takes more vertical space than a square lockup.
concepts.idea: Reference role: the original Silicon seal. Create a flat rotated-square silicon die, a diamond silhouette with slightly chamfered tips, two short contact tabs on each of its four sloping edges, and one large upright readable V cut out of its center. The V must remain upright while only the die outline is rotated. This is a flat geometric diamond, not an isometric cube or a shield. Beside it exact uppercase text "VERITY" in custom bold condensed sans serif, with the same diagonal angle echoed subtly in the V and Y. No 3D.

concepts.name: Pin V
concepts.description: The chip contacts become part of the V itself, removing the surrounding box for a simpler monogram.
concepts.tradeoff: Its hardware meaning is more abstract than the original seal.
concepts.idea: Reference role: the original Silicon seal. Explore a new bold monogram where the chip body itself is shaped like an uppercase V, NOT a square. Two broad diagonal ivory strokes converge at the base, with exactly two short rectangular chip-pin protrusions on the outside edge of each stroke. Just the V-shaped die and four integrated contacts, no surrounding box or badge. Strong simple clean original silhouette. Beside it exact uppercase text "VERITY" in custom bold very condensed uppercase sans serif. Keep pin protrusions modest and thick, not spiky or wing-like.

concepts.name: Chisel cut
concepts.description: A taller, narrower wordmark repeats a diagonal incision in the V and Y for a sharper architectural character.
concepts.tradeoff: The narrow letters need optical spacing to remain readable.
concepts.idea: Reference role: the original Cut wordmark. A typography-only custom logo, no separate symbol. Exact text "VERITY", uppercase. Much taller and narrower architectural letter proportions than the reference. Heavy condensed sans serif with large open counters. One restrained diagonal chisel incision repeated consistently at the inside base of V, the leg of R and the junction of Y; leave E I T clean. One coherent cutting angle, minimal intervention, tight expertly balanced kerning. No stencil breaks cutting entire letters apart, no sci-fi lettering. Warm ivory lettering only.

concepts.name: Wide cut
concepts.description: Broader letters and a quieter cut create a more spacious identity for headers and presentation titles.
concepts.tradeoff: The wider name occupies more horizontal room in the app.
concepts.idea: Reference role: the original Cut wordmark. Typography-only logo with exact uppercase text "VERITY", no separate emblem. Explore broad extended geometric sans-serif letters with medium-heavy strokes, noticeably wider and less dense than the reference. Precise square counters, modest letterspacing. A single tiny rectangular notch in the upper inner right arm of V and matching subtle cut in the R leg. The E, I, T and Y clean and clear. Premium understated engineering typography, confident without being blocky. Do not make it italic, condensed or stencil. Flat ivory wordmark.

concepts.name: Soft cut
concepts.description: Lowercase letters and softened corners make the same engineering brand feel more approachable.
concepts.tradeoff: It changes the current uppercase, instrument-panel character most.
concepts.idea: Reference role: the original Cut wordmark. Typography-only new custom wordmark, exact lowercase text "verity", spelled v e r i t y, no separate emblem. Bold slightly condensed geometric lowercase lettering with gently rounded exterior corners and squared interior counters, warm approachable precision. A small crisp diagonal incision only in the v and y. A clearly visible square dot over the i. Level baseline, generous open counters, refined tight optical kerning, no connected script, no slogan. The result should feel like a friendly but serious developer tool, not a toy brand.

concepts.name: Register cut
concepts.description: A squared technical wordmark uses even character rhythm and open counters to echo code and registers.
concepts.tradeoff: Uniform character spacing needs care around the I and T.
concepts.idea: Reference role: the original Cut wordmark. Typography-only custom wordmark exact uppercase text "VERITY", no separate emblem. Engineer a monospaced industrial sans serif wordmark with consistent character cell widths, medium-heavy uniform strokes, squared rounded-rectangle counters, a clearly readable serifless I with small horizontal top and bottom bars. Distinctive V has a flat small bottom terminal and a clean precise notch in its left inner arm; R has a rectangular bowl with one chamfered upper corner, Y echoes the V angle. Wider and lighter than the original Cut wordmark, code-like rhythmic yet sophisticated. No stencil, no pixel art.
